tvShow.name: Witch Hat Atelier
tvShow.originalName: とんがり帽子のアトリエ
tvShow.overview: In a world where only witches can cast magic, they must avoid being seen by ordinary people while casting. While Coco does her chores, she daydreams of becoming a witch. When a young witch named Qifrey visits her village, Coco uncovers the “absolute secret,” becomes Qifrey’s apprentice, and begins her studies. This is the story of children who encounter despair, yet reach out toward hope.

episodes.name: The Magic That Started Everything
episodes.overview: Coco, a girl fascinated by magic, meets Qifrey and discovers the secrets of witches.

episodes.name: The School of the Grassland
episodes.overview: Coco meets her fellow students and starts to learn the fundamentals of magic.

episodes.name: The Dadah Range Test
episodes.overview: While Qifrey is away, Agott pushes Coco into taking a dangerous test.

episodes.name: Meeting In Kalhn
episodes.overview: Qifrey takes Coco to the witches' town of Kalhn, where she has an unexpected encounter.

episodes.name: The Dragon's Labyrinth
episodes.overview: The four apprentice witches strive to find a solution to their calamitous situation.

episodes.name: A Light on a Rainy Day
episodes.overview: On a rainy day, the apprentices enjoy a picnic outside and meet their Watchful Eye.

crew.name: Claire Barbou des Courières
crew.original_name: クレール・バルブ デ クリエール

episodes.name: Who Is Magic For?
episodes.overview: The apprentices are allowed to come along on a dangerous rescue mission.

episodes.name: The Misgivings of the Knights Moralis
episodes.overview: When the Knights Moralis arrive, Coco and Agott must deal with the aftermath of their actions.

episodes.name: A Nightmare Stained In Black
episodes.overview: Qifrey investigates a new clue to the Brimmed Caps while Coco continues to struggle with guilt.

episodes.name: A Promise in Silver
episodes.overview: Coco lies ill in the hospital, while Tartah gains new self-confidence through magic.

episodes.name: The Test in Serpentback Cave
episodes.overview: Richeh reveals her distaste for spells that are not her own, while Agott gets the date for her second test.

episodes.name: The Shadow of Romonon
episodes.overview: Qifrey tells Coco the history of the Romonon cave, while Agott and the examinees face its topsy-turvy magic.

episodes.name: Forbidden Magic
episodes.overview: Trapped in the Serpentback Cave, Agott, Richeh, and Euini face a terrifying threat from a Brimmed Cap witch.
